title: HMX derivation record
description: The external provenance record shared by hmx derive and hmx materialize (spec §10.9). Root keys are serialized in ascending bytewise order: base_content_hash, created_at, derived_content_hash, derived_name, non_parameter_overrides, replaced, tool_version. JSON Schema validates the wire shape but cannot enforce serialization or array ordering.

created_at.description: A fresh RFC 3339 UTC timestamp created for this invocation.

non_parameter_overrides.description: Unique exact non-parameter FieldIds affected under --allow-non-parameter, serialized in ascending bytewise FieldId order. JSON Schema does not enforce this ordering.

replaced.description: Artifact changes sorted by ascending bytewise artifact_role, with sorted field_ids as the tie-breaker. JSON Schema does not enforce this ordering.

content_hash.title: HMX package content-hash
content_hash.description: The hmx-core-computed package hash (spec §9), serialized with keys in ascending bytewise order: algo, value.

replacement.title: HMX derivation artifact change
replacement.description: One replaced, removed, or added artifact, serialized with keys in ascending bytewise order: artifact_role, field_ids, new_sha256, old_sha256. Replacement entries have both digests, removals have only old_sha256, and additions have only new_sha256. For derive --set, field_ids contains only changed scalar keys. For derive --replace, field_ids contains every exact registered field affected by the artifact-level swap.

artifact_role.description: The non-empty role of the changed artifact in the package manifest.

field_ids.description: Unique exact registry FieldIds, sorted and deduplicated in ascending bytewise order. JSON Schema does not enforce this ordering.
